title: EV Charging Reserved Space — Time-of-Use Multiplier on Idle Charges
content:
Rate schedule note for the Parking License: at a dedicated charger — the charger of an EV Charging Reserved Space — idle charges follow the time of use of the charging session they belong to.

## Note

At a dedicated charger, when the charging session of the idle fee line delivered no on-peak energy, the scheduled idle fee is 0.5 times the hourly charges; at a dedicated charger, when that session delivered some on-peak energy, the scheduled idle fee is 0.75 times the hourly charges; in every other case the scheduled idle fee is the hourly charges themselves. The session multiplier applies to the hourly charges as a whole, and the scheduled idle fee is rounded half up to the cent only once, after the multiplier.

**Identifying the session.** An idle fee line and the energy lines of its charging session carry the same charging network session reference. The session delivered on-peak energy when an on-peak energy line with that session reference is on the license; it delivered none when no energy line of that session is on-peak.

## Multiplier by case

| Charger | Energy lines of the session | Scheduled idle fee |
|---|---|---|
| dedicated (EV Charging Reserved Space) | no on-peak line | 0.5 times the hourly charges |
| dedicated (EV Charging Reserved Space) | at least one on-peak line | 0.75 times the hourly charges |
| shared charger, any product | any | the hourly charges themselves |

## Worked examples (hypothetical hourly charges of $38.75)

- Off-peak-only session at a dedicated charger: $38.75 multiplied by 0.5 is $19.375, rounded half up once to $19.38.
- Session with on-peak energy at a dedicated charger: $38.75 multiplied by 0.75 is $29.0625, rounded once to $29.06.
- Shared-charger session: the scheduled idle fee is $38.75.

The multiplier is applied to the hourly charges as one amount, never hour by hour, and nothing is rounded before it is applied.
